interpretations_recorded_at_freeze2: G2u: the +-1 deg runs at 0.09 are optional inputs (the SHIFT_UNVERIFIED rule of 6.3 implies it); the 11 others and every realisation-pair run (both levels) are required inputs
sigma_real80: a pair is excluded only when its two mesh files are identical; fewer than 2 pairs is an undefined quantity (FAIL_VALUE)
Q1 at x134 0 and x09 0: a lost U or US1 leaves the start dependence unchecked (INDETERMINATE); different classes of two non-lost runs are START_DEPENDENT
Controls without a registered Udt2 (f09 0) have no time-step check; CONTROL_OK does not need one
A stage-2 run whose source run (S0, or S1 for US1) is SOLVER_FAIL, MECHANICAL_FAIL or INFRA_LOSS takes that class (6.1 'the source run failed')
Cost: a copied base adds its base's generation time; with DATA and DIFF PASS an undetermined cost gives T20D_INCOMPLETE (unreachable: all 15 cost runs are DIFF inputs)
The S0 class against the T2-0c class (6.2 'also reported') is not computed by the analyzer, because section 2 forbids reading T2-0a/b/c output there; it goes into the dated note after the analysis
KeyError/TypeError inside a gate are analyzer defects (the analyzer stops without writing; section 8's crash rule), not FAIL_VALUE
The analyzer refuses (no output) when a COMPLETED run has no extracted case files (cases.tar not extracted)
analysis_rule: scripts/analyze_t20d.py at the source commit, run once on the six downloaded and extracted outputs; --completeness only before that
output_packaging: cases.tar per kernel (Kaggle output API 429 after ~2400 per-file downloads); extracted with tarfile's data filter and checked against artifact_manifest.json
